proposal.summary: GitLab projects API pagination can be skipped in multiple versions, potentially allowing a denial of service on some instances.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab: all versions starting from 15.2 before 16.1.5; all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

A.quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Advise updating affected GitLab instances to the fixed versions listed (>=16.1.5 for 15.2+, >=16.2.5 for 16.2+, >=16.3.1 for 16.3+) or apply the vendor patch; notify administrators to apply the update and monitor API usage for abnormal request patterns.

evidence_quotes.quote: An issue has been discovered in GitLab affecting all versions starting from 15.2 before 16.1.5, all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5, all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.
